note: Integrates Tiny Slider 2. No configure route. Field formatter id 'tiny_slider_field_formatter' (label 'Tiny Slider Carousel', field types image + entity_reference), Views style id 'tiny_slider'. Drush command tiny_slider:download / ts:dl fetches the JS library into /libraries/tiny-slider (library is NOT bundled; hook_requirements warns if missing, but display config can still be set). Shared option keys from TinySliderGlobal::defaultSettings(): items, gutter, mode, nav, autoplay(+hoverPause/buttonOutput), controls, slideBy, loop, center, speed, responsive items, advancedMode+configJson. Formatter settings live in entity_view_display; Views options in the view entity. Medium reads a seeded formatter (items=5); hard switches a field's formatter to tiny_slider and reconfigures items/autoplay, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: I want to display a multi-value image field as a carousel on a Drupal site using the tiny_slider module. Which field formatter do I choose and which field types does it support?
evals.expected_output: On Manage display pick the 'Tiny Slider Carousel' formatter (id tiny_slider_field_formatter). It supports image and entity_reference fields. There is also a 'TinySlider' Views style (id tiny_slider) for view rows.

evals.prompt: After enabling tiny_slider the slider does not initialize and there is a requirements error about the library. How do I install the Tiny Slider JS library, including any drush command?
evals.expected_output: The Tiny Slider JS library is not bundled; it must be placed in /libraries/tiny-slider. Run drush tiny_slider:download (alias ts:dl) to fetch and extract it there, or download the release manually. hook_requirements() clears once /libraries/tiny-slider/dist/tiny-slider.js exists.

evals.prompt: In the tiny_slider formatter/Views style, which option controls how many slides are visible and how do I turn on auto-advance? Is there a way to pass raw Tiny Slider options the form does not expose?
evals.expected_output: The 'items' option sets how many slides show; 'autoplay' turns on auto-advance. For anything the form omits, enable advancedMode and paste a raw Tiny Slider JSON options object into configJson, which overrides the individual settings when it is valid JSON.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an image field field_ts_known displayed with the Tiny Slider formatter. Inspect the live default view display and report how many items (slides) it is configured to show.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ts_known component uses formatter tiny_slider_field_formatter with settings.items = 5.

evals.prompt: The Article field field_ts_known on this site is rendered as a slider. Inspect the live display configuration and name the exact field formatter plugin applied to it.
evals.expected_output: The field_ts_known component in node.article.default uses formatter type tiny_slider_field_formatter (label 'Tiny Slider Carousel').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an image field field_ts_task currently shown with the core Image formatter. Using tiny_slider, change its default display to render as a Tiny Slider carousel (tiny_slider_field_formatter) and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ts_task component type is set to tiny_slider_field_formatter (set the formatter on Manage display or via the entity_view_display and save).

evals.prompt: The Article field field_ts_tune on this site already uses the Tiny Slider formatter, currently showing 1 item with autoplay off. Reconfigure it to show 4 items and enable autoplay, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In node.article.default the field_ts_tune tiny_slider_field_formatter settings set items = 4 and autoplay = true, saved to the live display.
